description: Figure: VAM10-frame dN/dS versus shifted antisense frames and a simulated null preserving Vps5p evolution
code:
import requests, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd, itertools as it
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
EU="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
GENES={"S. cerevisiae":"854235","S. paradoxus":"54633636","S. mikatae":"80921287",
       "S. kudriavzevii":"80927111","S. eubayanus":"28934048"}
sm=S.get(EU+"esummary.fcgi",params=dict(db="gene",id=",".join(GENES.values()),retmode="json"),timeout=90).json()["result"]
def ef(acc,s,e,st):
    for _ in range(5):
        t=S.get(EU+"efetch.fcgi",params=dict(db="nuccore",id=acc,rettype="fasta",retmode="text",
                seq_start=s,seq_stop=e,strand=st),timeout=120).text
        q="".join(t.split("\n")[1:]).upper()
        if len(q)>500: return q
        time.sleep(2)
    return ""
CDS={}
for nm,gid in GENES.items():
    L=sm[gid]["genomicinfo"][0]; a,b=int(L["chrstart"]),int(L["chrstop"])
    s,e,st=(a+1,b+1,1) if a<=b else (b+1,a+1,2)
    CDS[nm]=ef(L["chraccver"],s,e,st); time.sleep(0.4)
bases="TCAG";aas="FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
CODON={};i=0
for b1 in bases:
    for b2 in bases:
        for b3 in bases:
            CODON[b1+b2+b3]=aas[i];i+=1
SYN={}
for c,a in CODON.items(): SYN.setdefault(a,[]).append(c)
tr=lambda s:"".join(CODON.get(s[k:k+3],"X") for k in range(0,len(s)-2,3))
COMP=str.maketrans("ACGT-","TGCA-"); rc=lambda s:s.translate(COMP)[::-1]
NT="TCAG"
def syn_sites(c):
    if "-" in c or CODON.get(c) in (None,"*"): return None
    return sum(sum(1 for b in NT if b!=c[p] and CODON[c[:p]+b+c[p+1:]]==CODON[c])/3.0 for p in range(3))
def pathways(c1,c2):
    d=[k for k in range(3) if c1[k]!=c2[k]]
    if not d: return 0.,0.
    ts=tn=0.;n_=0
    for perm in it.permutations(d):
        cur=c1;s=n=0;ok=True
        for k in perm:
            nx=cur[:k]+c2[k]+cur[k+1:]
            if CODON[nx]=="*": ok=False;break
            if CODON[nx]==CODON[cur]: s+=1
            else: n+=1
            cur=nx
        if ok: ts+=s;tn+=n;n_+=1
    return (ts/n_,tn/n_) if n_ else (0.,float(len(d)))
jc=lambda p: float("nan") if (p is None or p>=0.749) else -0.75*np.log(1-4*p/3)
def ng(s1,s2,fr=0):
    SS=NN=SD=ND=0.0
    for k in range(fr,min(len(s1),len(s2))-2,3):
        c1,c2=s1[k:k+3],s2[k:k+3]
        a,b=syn_sites(c1),syn_sites(c2)
        if a is None or b is None: continue
        Sx=(a+b)/2.; SS+=Sx; NN+=3-Sx
        sd,nd=pathways(c1,c2); SD+=sd; ND+=nd
    return SD/SS, ND/NN, SD, ND
VAM10="MLFEVFGEVLASYIVSSKTKGELAFPVNNAPPDSLVAINCVVLFLRSAIGSCSGAKELIRSSALELSCSSSCGLPATDKPGSFHSGALSKSILSANEAVVSKSSLSFLSSFVDI"
ref="S. cerevisiae"; a_ref=CDS[ref][99:447]
rng=np.random.default_rng(11)
SP=["S. paradoxus","S. mikatae","S. kudriavzevii","S. eubayanus"]
obs_v=[];obs_s1=[];obs_s2=[];nulls=[]
for sp in SP:
    p0=tr(CDS[ref]).rstrip("*"); p1=tr(CDS[sp]).rstrip("*")
    best=(-1,0)
    for off in range(-6,7):
        st=33+off
        if st<0 or st+116>len(p1): continue
        sc=sum(1 for x,y in zip(p0[33:149],p1[st:st+116]) if x==y)
        if sc>best[0]: best=(sc,off)
    off=best[1]; a_sp=CDS[sp][3*(33+off):3*(33+off)+348]
    _,_,SDv,_=ng(a_ref,a_sp,0)
    ra,rb=rc(a_ref),rc(a_sp)
    f=[k for k in range(3) if tr(ra[k:]).startswith(VAM10[:15])][0]
    o=[]
    for fr in [f,(f+1)%3,(f+2)%3]:
        s,n,_,_=ng(ra,rb,fr); o.append(jc(n)/jc(s))
    obs_v.append(o[0]); obs_s1.append(o[1]); obs_s2.append(o[2])
    aa_ref=[CODON[a_ref[3*k:3*k+3]] for k in range(116)]
    aa_sp=[CODON[a_sp[3*k:3*k+3]] for k in range(116)]
    def sim():
        cods=[]
        for k in range(116):
            c=a_ref[3*k:3*k+3]
            if aa_sp[k]!=aa_ref[k]:
                cand=SYN[aa_sp[k]]
                d=[sum(1 for q in range(3) if c[q]!=x[q]) for x in cand]
                mn=min(d); pick=[x for x,dd in zip(cand,d) if dd==mn]
                c=pick[rng.integers(len(pick))]
            cods.append(c)
        K=int(round(SDv)); t=0
        while K>0 and t<5000:
            t+=1; k=int(rng.integers(116)); q=int(rng.integers(3)); c=cods[k]
            al=[b for b in NT if b!=c[q] and CODON[c[:q]+b+c[q+1:]]==CODON[c]]
            if not al: continue
            cods[k]=c[:q]+al[rng.integers(len(al))]+c[q+1:]; K-=1
        return "".join(cods)
    nv=[]
    for _ in range(200):
        rs=rc(sim()); s,n,_,_=ng(ra,rs,f); dS,dN=jc(s),jc(n)
        if dS==dS and dS>0: nv.append(dN/dS)
    nulls.append(np.array(nv))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.2))
ax=axes[0]
x=np.arange(len(SP)); w=0.26
ax.bar(x-w, obs_v, w, color="#c2410c", label="VAM10 reading frame")
ax.bar(x,    obs_s1, w, color="#94a3b8", label="antisense frame +1 (no ORF)")
ax.bar(x+w,  obs_s2, w, color="#cbd5e1", label="antisense frame +2 (no ORF)")
ax.axhline(1.0, ls=":", c="k", lw=1)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(SP, rotation=15); ax.set_ylabel("dN/dS")
ax.set_title("Shifted-frame control inside the same 348 bp of VPS5")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, frameon=False)

ax=axes[1]
pos=np.arange(len(SP))
bp=ax.violinplot([n for n in nulls], positions=pos, showextrema=False, widths=0.8)
for b in bp['bodies']: b.set_facecolor("#94a3b8"); b.set_alpha(0.6)
ax.plot(pos, obs_v, "D", color="#c2410c", ms=10, label="observed VAM10-frame dN/dS")
for p,(o,n) in enumerate(zip(obs_v,nulls)):
    pv=(n<=o).mean()
    ax.text(p, o-0.13, f"p={pv:.3f}", ha="center", fontsize=9, color="#c2410c")
ax.axhline(1.0, ls=":", c="k", lw=1)
ax.set_xticks(pos); ax.set_xticklabels(SP, rotation=15); ax.set_ylabel("dN/dS in the VAM10 frame")
ax.set_title("Simulated null: Vps5p changes fixed,\nsynonymous changes placed at random (n=200)")
ax.legend(fontsize=9, frameon=False, loc="upper left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print(pd.DataFrame(dict(species=SP, VAM10_frame=np.round(obs_v,3), shift1=np.round(obs_s1,3),
                        shift2=np.round(obs_s2,3),
                        null_median=[round(float(np.median(n)),3) for n in nulls],
                        p_one_sided=[round(float((n<=o).mean()),4) for n,o in zip(nulls,obs_v)])).to_string(index=False))
